lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb8K4Ag4Cl24 (reduced formula Rb2KAgCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ag and K centers, each coordinated by six Cl neighbors, while Rb adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Cl neighbors; Cl centers have two geometric neighbors, one Ag and one K. The same analysis reports a single three-dimensional geometric neighbor component spanning all 40 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ag and K octahedra and face-sharing between Rb 12-vertex polyhedra and both Ag and K octahedra.
